text:
emma_sales: Kestrel Data (third-party vendor) escalated — they were billed a pass-through license fee twice this quarter and are asking for a retroactive credit + discounted vendor rate for 6 months to keep partnership.
vendor_kestrel: We were invoiced twice for the same data license on invoice KD-2026-Q1. That was a platform-side duplication, pls advise.
rohan_revops: Can you paste the invoice lines and the vendor feed audit? @billing-bot
billing-bot: Invoice KD-2026-Q1 lines:\n1) Data license passthrough: $12,000\n2) Data license passthrough (duplicated): $12,000\n3) Platform integration fee: $1,200\nNet: $25,200\nAudit: Duplicate charge detected for license SKU KD-LIC-STD on billing dates 2026-03-01 and 2026-03-15. Ticket BILL-4882 opened.
marta_finance: Ouch. Duplicate charge looks like an ingestion retry bug that re-inserted the vendor charge. We should correct this promptly. My discretionary credit cap is $10k; beyond that requires CFO sign-off.
jules_legal: If the duplication is our error we should issue a full refund/credit for the duplicated pass-through and document an exception. Also need to update vendor contract to prevent similar disputes and include invoice reconciliation windows.
emma_sales: Vendor is asking for a $12k credit plus a temporary 20% vendor discount for the next 6 months as a retention gesture. They say the duplicate billing caused cashflow stress.
rohan_revops: Kestrel is strategic (connectors roadmap), ARR influence modest but they bring a lot of upstream data. I support a goodwill concession plus operational fixes.
marta_finance: I'll approve issuing the $12k credit for the duplicated line as it's clearly our error. For the 20% discount, I can approve up to a 3-month vendor discount as a one-time commercial concession; beyond that needs VP of Revenue approval.
jules_legal: If we do 6 months of discounted vendor rates we need a short amendment and a written acceptance from Kestrel. I'll draft an addendum and an internal exception memo to record the precedent.
vendor_kestrel: Appreciate the quick reply. If Redwood covers the duplicate $12k and we get 6 months at 20% off feed fees, we will accelerate roadmap integrations and extend our co-marketing commitments.
marta_finance: Given the partnership upside, I'm ok to support 6 months of 20% discount but require: 1) signed vendor amendment within 7 business days, 2) logging the exception in deal-exceptions ledger, 3) require billing guard to prevent duplicate passthroughs. jules_legal to draft; rohan_revops to implement guard.
rohan_revops: I'll implement a dedupe rule on vendor passthrough invoices and add an alert for repeated SKUs within a 30-day window. Ticket REV-839 created.
billing-bot: Created credit memo CM-KD-2026-03 for $12,000. Pending amendment upload and final sign-off.
emma_sales: I'll coordinate with Kestrel to sign amendment and confirm co-marketing deliverables.
jules_legal: Draft uploaded to /vendors/drafts/Kestrel_amend_2026.pdf and exception memo logged under DE-839. Please review.
marta_finance: Applying credit now conditional on amendment: applying $12,000 credit memo to KD-2026-Q1 pending signed amendment. Also approving 20% vendor discount for 6 months conditional on signed addendum and co-marketing commitment.
billing-bot: Credit applied pending amendment. Net invoice updated. Please confirm when final doc uploaded.
vendor_kestrel: Amendment signed and uploaded at 1839994500. Confirm you received it.
billing-bot: Amendment received. Credit applied. Vendor discount window scheduled from 2026-04-01 to 2026-09-30 at 20%. Exception recorded DE-839. :white_check_mark:
marta_finance: Closing thread. Actions: 1) credit applied, 2) vendor amendment filed, 3) revops dedupe rule deployed, 4) exception logged. Thanks everyone.
